about: Two candidates from stored role-v29 answers (docs/research/2026-10-29-analyst-standard/loop-2026-10-29/v29/answers.sqlite), copied unchanged: NVIDIA FY2028 total revenue proposed on 2026-07-02 (next fiscal year: FY2027 ends in January 2027) and calendar-2028 AI capex proposed on 2026-07-06 (the year after next).

candidate.question: What will Nvidia's total revenue be in FY2028?

rungs.label: Strongly bullish
rungs.condition: FY2028 total revenue is below $443.2 billion.

rungs.label: Bullish
rungs.condition: FY2028 total revenue is at least $443.2 billion and below $498.6 billion.

rungs.label: Neutral
rungs.condition: FY2028 total revenue is at least $498.6 billion and below $609.4 billion, within 10% of the cited $554 billion estimate.

rungs.label: Bearish
rungs.condition: FY2028 total revenue is at least $609.4 billion and below $664.8 billion.

rungs.label: Strongly bearish
rungs.condition: FY2028 total revenue is at least $664.8 billion.

candidate.settled_by: Nvidia's FY2028 annual report, reporting total revenue for the fiscal year.

candidate.looks_at: Annual AI capex including GPUs, networking, storage, attached CPU compute and data centres
candidate.question: How much will annual AI capex amount to in calendar 2028?

rungs.label: Lowest range
rungs.condition: Annual AI capex is below $1.5 trillion.

rungs.label: Lower-middle range
rungs.condition: Annual AI capex is at least $1.5 trillion and below $2 trillion.

rungs.label: Neutral comparison
rungs.condition: Annual AI capex is at least $2 trillion and below $2.5 trillion.

rungs.label: Upper-middle range
rungs.condition: Annual AI capex is at least $2.5 trillion and below $3 trillion.

rungs.label: Highest range
rungs.condition: Annual AI capex is at least $3 trillion.

candidate.scope: AI capex including GPUs, networking, storage, attached CPU compute and data centres
candidate.settled_by: A comprehensive published 2028 calendar-year estimate of aggregate AI capex.
